descriptionByLocale.en:
Are you energised by transforming complexity into clarity? Do you thrive on building high-performing teams, driving accountability, and delivering outcomes that genuinely move the needle? If you are ready to shape the future of Life & Health Operations at a global scale, this is the role for you.

About the Role

This is a high-impact leadership opportunity at the heart of Swiss Re's L&H Operations. As Head Business Architecture L&H Operations, you will set the standard for how we execute across the full treaty life cycle — from onboarding through to claims payments. You will drive operational excellence with pace and discipline, strengthen governance and quality, and build the capabilities, mindset, and execution muscle that enable our global Operations teams to consistently deliver for clients, stakeholders, and the business.

Key Responsibilities

• Set the bar for operational rigor and accountability — create a sustainable, trusted, and resilient Operations function that is built to perform at the highest level

• Drive process alignment, simplification, and continuous improvement — maintain a relentless focus on execution, measurable outcomes, and delivery against Operations KPIs

• Identify, prioritise, and execute operational excellence opportunities — remove friction, accelerate delivery, and make it easier for teams to do their best work

• Define standard Operations processes — lead the design, testing, execution, and rollout of end-to-end process and system enhancements

• Own the Operations governance and quality assurance framework — embed consistent risk appetite, strong controls, and a proactive risk culture across global Operations teams

• Build frameworks and operational discipline — ensure portfolio data is trusted, usable, and actionable for analytics and decision-making

• Turn standardisation and automation opportunities into delivered improvements — enable scalable growth and stronger business performance

• Build and energise a global community of Operations experts — establish clear roles, responsibilities, deliverables, and shared standards of excellence

• Create compelling expert career paths — attract, develop, and retain outstanding Operations talent across the globe

• Lead and deliver strategic projects and initiatives — drive clear ownership, strong stakeholder engagement, and close collaboration with regional teams, Market Units, COO, CUO, and other key partners

About the Team

You will lead a global team of 20+ talented colleagues across key Swiss Re locations, working at the very heart of L&H Operations. This team operates in close partnership with Market Units, Operational Excellence, Risk Management, COO, CUO, and wider Operations teams worldwide. Far from being a support function, this team is expected to be a genuine catalyst — driving sharper execution, stronger standards, and practical transformation that turns strategy into progress and progress into measurable business impact. If you are looking for a team where your leadership truly matters and your work leaves a visible mark on the business, this is it.

About You

You are an inspirational, hands-on leader who combines strategic thinking with a bias for action. You bring the courage to challenge constructively, the judgement to make pragmatic trade-offs, and the resilience to push important work through to completion. You communicate with impact, build credibility through delivery, and motivate diverse global teams to move with purpose, confidence, and urgency.

We are looking for candidates who meet these requirements:

• Proven track record of leading large, diverse global teams — with a demonstrated ability to create clarity, energy, and accountability that drives consistently strong outcomes

• Strong project and change management expertise — with the ability to translate strategy into clear plans, decisive action, and delivering results that land with impact

• Demonstrated success in operational excellence and process improvement — a consistent record of simplifying complexity, raising operational standards, and delivering tangible, measurable improvements at pace

• Deep experience in governance and quality assurance frameworks — including risk management, controls design, and embedding a proactive risk culture across large, distributed teams

• Excellent communication and senior stakeholder influencing skills — with the ability to build followership through transparency, credibility, and delivery across complex, matrixed organisations

These are additional nice to haves:

• Experience in Life & Health reinsurance or insurance operations, with familiarity of the treaty life cycle from onboarding through to claims

• Exposure to data strategy, portfolio data management, or analytics enablement within an operations context

• Experience designing and executing automation or digitalisation initiatives within an operations environment

• Familiarity with COO/CUO operating models and working across Market Units in a global reinsurance or financial services setting

• A college degree or equivalent professional qualification in a relevant discipline

• Multilingual capabilities — excellent spoken and written English is essential; additional languages are a plus

• A track record of building expert communities and creating career development frameworks that attract and retain top talent

For Slovakia, the base salary range for this position is between EUR 5,000 and EUR 8,300 monthly for a full-time role.

The specific salary offered considers:

• The requirements, scope, complexity and responsibilities of the role

• The applicant's own profile including education/qualifications, expertise, specialisation, skills and experience

In the situation where you do not meet all the requirements or you significantly exceed these, the offered salary may be below or above the advertised range. In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible for additional rewards and benefits including an attractive performance-based annual bonus.

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.

About Swiss Re
Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.

Lead Data Architect
 Are you passionate about turning data into a strategic asset that drives real-world impact? Do you thrive at the intersection of business strategy, cutting-edge technology, and architectural innovation? If so, this is your opportunity to shape the data foundations of one of the world's leading reinsurance organisations — and help make the world more resilient.

About the Role
 As a Lead Data Architect at Swiss Re, you will be at the heart of our Data Analytics Solutions — guiding end-to-end data architecture and serving as the critical bridge between business stakeholders and engineering teams. Your work will directly influence how data, analytics, and AI create value for our clients and partners. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role where architectural excellence meets strategic purpose.
 Key Responsibilities

• Collaborate across boundaries – Partner with P&C Reinsurance business and IT teams, as well as the broader Swiss Re organisation, to translate complex business requirements into clear, actionable data architecture designs.

• Design with purpose – Create logical data models and end-to-end data flows that are scalable, reliable, and tightly aligned with evolving business needs.

• Lead and enable – Guide and mentor data engineers in implementing physical data models , data flows, and data access controls, fostering a culture of architectural excellence and continuous improvement.

• Empower through clarity – Own and evolve data product definitions , data catalogues, data models, and other design artefacts that empower data consumers across the organisation.

• Embrace innovation – Leverage AI tools and techniques within the data architecture function to drive efficiency, accelerate delivery, and unlock new possibilities.

• Ensure compliance and trust – Uphold alignment with Swiss Re's data governance standards and security requirements, ensuring data is managed as a trusted, high-quality asset across its full lifecycle.

About the Team
 At Swiss Re, our mission is to make the world more resilient. The P&C Re Architecture team plays a pivotal role in advancing that mission — shaping the data, technology, and architectural foundations that enable better risk understanding, stronger decisions, and trusted analytics across the reinsurance business.
 We are a collaborative, forward-thinking team that works closely with colleagues across business and IT to build the infrastructure that powers trusted data, advanced analytics, and AI-driven insights. Our work supports better decisions, strengthens resilience, and creates lasting value for our clients around the globe. If you are energised by solving complex data challenges at enterprise scale and want your work to have a meaningful real-world impact, you will feel right at home here.

About You
 You understand that data is a strategic asset and take pride in building solutions and establishing processes that make it trustworthy, accessible, and impactful. You bring a collaborative spirit, a curious mind, and the confidence to communicate complex architectural concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. You are comfortable leading others, navigating ambiguity, and working across cultures and time zones to deliver meaningful outcomes.
 We Are Looking for Candidates Who Meet These Requirements:

• Strong data modelling expertise – Proven, hands-on experience with both 3NF and dimensional modelling approaches, with the ability to design models that serve diverse analytical needs across the enterprise.

• Data architecture experience – Solid working knowledge of data warehousing, data lake, and data mesh architectures in complex, enterprise-scale environments.

• Data management proficiency – Practical experience enabling data analytics professionals through data sourcing, data profiling, data transformation, data quality management, master/reference data management, data cataloguing, data lifecycle management , and access management.

• Architectural leadership – Demonstrated experience providing architectural guidance to teams of data engineers , with a track record of translating strategy into execution and driving engineering best practices.

• Communication and stakeholder management – Strong written and verbal communication skills in English , with the ability to engage effectively with multicultural, globally distributed teams and translate business needs into well-structured, data-centric solutions.

These Are Additional Nice to Haves:

• Re/Insurance industry knowledge – Familiarity with the Property & Casualty (P&C) domain, including an understanding of how data supports risk assessment and decision-making across the end-to-end reinsurance value chain.

• Experience working with AI/ML-driven data platforms and integrating AI capabilities into data architecture practices.

• Exposure to cloud-native data platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP) and modern data stack tooling.

• Experience working in globally distributed, cross-functional teams across multiple time zones.

• Familiarity with data mesh principles and experience driving decentralised data ownership models.

Our company has a hybrid work model where the expectation is that you will be in the office at least three days per week.

IT Business Analyst for Finance Reporting & Analytics
 About the role
 We are looking for an IT Business Analyst to join our team, supporting business-critical data-driven solutions.
 This role requires a well-balanced profile combining technical capabilities with solid business analysis expertise. The ideal candidate brings a hands-on technical background (e.g., software development or similar) and is motivated to connect systems, data, and business processes to drive practical and scalable Reporting & Analytics solutions.
 Curiosity, adaptability, and a strong willingness to learn are key success factors in this role.
 Key Responsibilities

• Translate business requirements into clear and structured technical specifications, and ensure transparent delivery with visibility on progress, risks and dependencies.

• Take end-to-end ownership of feature implementation and improvement initiatives, from requirements definition through implementation and validation.

• Partner with business stakeholders to understand needs, refine requirements, and propose scalable and pragmatic solutions.

• Drive the implementation of new products and features and provide ongoing support for existing Reporting & Analytics applications and data products in a BAU environment.

• Support Product Owners in product backlog management and delivery planning, ensuring alignment between business priorities and technical readiness.

• Perform in-depth data analysis to validate business logic, transform data, and ensure consistency and reliability.

• Collaborate closely with engineers, developers and architects to design robust and maintainable solutions aligned with enterprise standards.

• Ensure proper documentation, traceability, and adherence to governance and control standards.

• Identify opportunities for process optimization and continuous improvement.
 About the Team
 You will join the Palantir Foundry Reporting & Analytics Solutions team, a high‑impact product team working at the intersection of Finance, data, and technology. The team delivers and runs modern, scalable, reliable, and data-driven solutions that enable better decision-making and operational efficiency.
 Collaboration, ownership, and continuous improvement are at the core of how we work. You will join a supportive and dynamic environment where initiative, accountability, professional growth are valued and you’ll find a supportive environment that encourages idea-sharing and mutual respect.
 About You
 You're a passionate professional who thrives in collaborative environments and gets energized by solving complex problems. You have a talent for translating business needs into technical requirements and can effectively communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You're data-driven, customer-focused, and committed to continuous improvement.
 We are looking for a candidate who meets these requirements:

• 5 – 8+ years of experience in IT Business Analysis or hybrid technical/business roles, ideally in Finance, Sustainability and/or Reporting & Analytics.

• Ability to operate independently and drive initiatives with minimal supervision.

• Experience with database concepts, data structures and software development (e.g., Python, PySpark, SQL).

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to bridge business and technology and influence at multiple seniority levels.

• Ability to translate business requirements into implementable technical solutions, balancing feasibility, scalability, and delivery constraints.

• Proven experience with Palantir Foundry or comparable modern data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake), combined with a background in Finance / Sustainability / FP&A and the (Re-)Insurance industry is a strong advantage.

• Strong analytical and problem‑solving mindset, including familiarity with product delivery and performance metrics to drive continuous improvement.

• Strong command of Agile ways of working and environments (e.g., Azure DevOps, Jira).

• Experience applying AI technologies and techniques to support product development and business analysis processes.

• Knowledge of data governance and data quality principles.

• Learning mindset and adaptability to new business domains.

We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 15,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.
 We may use AI-powered tools to support the review and evaluation of applications for this position. These tools provide additional insights to our recruitment teams, but all hiring decisions are carefully reviewed and made by people. To learn more about how we use AI in recruitment and how we handle your personal data, please review our Data Privacy Statement before applying.
